rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for possession, availability, family relationships, contents, scheduled classes, illnesses, and having children.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 loeng5 bun2 siu2 syut3

rows.note: Use this when “have” means to do or undertake an activity, such as having a look or having a meeting.

example.english: We have an interview this afternoon.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 zau3 zou6 go3 fong2 man6

rows.note: Use this when “have” refers to food or a meal, such as having breakfast; drinks normally use 飲 instead.

example.english: I have breakfast in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 sik6 zou2 caan1

rows.note: Use this when someone experiences or goes through an event or period.

example.english: We have gone through a very difficult year.
example.traditional: 我哋經歷過好艱難嘅一年。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ging1 lik6 gwo3 hou2 gaan1 naan4 ge3 jat1 nin4
